diagnosis.original_evidence: The source currently assigns clipCorrection._11=hudScaleX in R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants while R30TransformXyzrhwStereo and paired-eye UP use hudScaleX*state.eyeScale[eye] for identical paused overlay ownership.
source_trace: Original STATE_SMPAUSEMENU produces generic ScreenOverlay2D shell with Shader WVP and ExactScreenHudClipSprite YES/NO arrows with XYZRHW.
R30IsPauseMenuElement gates both producers and R30HudContainScale calculates same common optical size with vertical FOV adjustment.
R30BuildEyeAffine yields per-eye horizontal dilation and offset, consumed by XYZRHW but only offset consumed by shader WVP, causing per-eye differential X scaling.
diagnosis.root_cause: Shader-backed ESC shell lacks the per-eye horizontal FOV dilation that exact original pause option arrows already get on XYZRHW, so asymmetric headset eye FOV separates their geometry despite common scale and vertical placement.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change `R30BuildEyeAffine` which is shared across gameplay/world and tested; preserving its eyeScale/offset and correcting only opt-in pause shader fixes the asymmetric horizontal mismatch without affecting nonpause HUD.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Add explicit pause-owned shader eye-FOV horizontal scale path, match XYZRHW equivalent under nonunity eyeScale while retaining existing non-pause shader scale.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable C++ eye-pair equation comparison and unity/nonpause invariants, plus source integration checks and mutation tests in existing ESC verifier.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both left and right eyes use their own verified eyeScale and eyeOffset on exact paused screen producers; unrelated F11 and world/UI draws keep previous shader correction.
